t: A laptop-class Snapdragon board that runs Linux or Windows on Arm.
steps: Order the Dragon Q8B from Arace, Ameridroid, or Allnet China.
Get a 65 watt USB-C PD power adapter and an NVMe drive or microSD card.
Add an M.2 E-key Wi-Fi card for wireless networking.
Download Radxa OS or a generic Ubuntu, Fedora, or Debian ISO from the Radxa download page.
Turn on the third-party OS setting in the BIOS for generic ISOs or Windows.
Boot the board and follow the Radxa docs for first setup.
Open a terminal and run a short Python script.
Ask questions on the Radxa forum.
meta: Open Board. From $149. A few stores.
